reviews.t: So easy to use. Love this product.
reviews.x: I’ve been using our dremel at it’s lowest speed setting for a few years. My dog is NOT a fan of the noise it creates. I wish I would’ve seen this kit before I started using the dremel. My puppy is perfectly happy letting me do her nails once we get her calmed down and laying still. My adult dog is not trusting of it yet but she is much more ok with it than the dremel. My process is trim the nails with the clippers and then smooth them out with the nail grinder. I haven’t had to use the handled f

This product worked great for all six of our pets. We have three dogs and three cats, this grinder worked great on all of them. Even our most skiddish rescue (pic for attention). The clippers and file worked great for getting the finer edges the grinder couldn’t angle to. It’s super quiet and didn’t require the typical “warm up/adjustment” period from previous motorized grinders for their noise.  I have already purchased a second one as a gift to my mom for her puppy and cats.  The motor is quie

I've never clipped any of my dogs nails strictly out of fear of cutting their quick.  Unfortunately, my current dog freaked out at the vet when he was a puppy so they will only cut them if he is sedated.  Um, no.  So, I read up on tips and tricks on  the easiest, quickest way to cut dogs nails, as well as good products.  Gave this one a try.  I totally recommend getting the dog used to the tool before using.  I did this for about a week before I tried clipping his nails.  ALSO, I've been told th

reviews.t: Not Enough stars for this amazing product
reviews.x: Okay I never write a review this fast. I just received my package today I have a shih tzu pekingese and a shepherd Pomeranian mix. I use the Clippers that came in a set and I use the grinder and I can tell you it works amazing. My girls were not upset by the sound or the noise cuz I have used my personal nail files on them and this was so much quieter and so much better I can never have gotten it as good as this did. I have to say it is great set a great product I highly recommend this to anyone

reviews.t: Why did I pay a groomer for so long??
reviews.x: Absolutely perfect! It arrived this afternoon and grinding my EB nails was job #1 -  I’ve spent years paying $25 per dog to have their nails ground and have never been satisfied with the job done. This was so easy, my dogs weren’t startled or afraid of the noise as there was almost none.  I don’t know why I’ve waited so long to do this myself!
Super happy with them. Use them for Great Danes and lab. 👍🏽

First one had a crack in the case, but otherwise appeared well made. Ordered a replacement which came equally fast. After charging, we ran it across our dogs feet and legs while it was turned on just to get over the sound and feel of it. Next step involved me grinding the nails while my daughter distracted our dog with loving and treats. Didn't take alot off, just enough for her to get used to it and get rid of the points. Today was able to do a lot more by myself and treats. Everything worked g

reviews.t: What you see is NOT what you get
reviews.x: We only received the grinder and extra grinding wheel with our order. No clippers or carrying bag or anything else.  The grinder is quiet and appears to be sturdy enough for use on our big Weimaraner toes. With that said, their toenails are big enough that we need to turn the grinder sideways in order to use it and we cannot get impatient while using the grinder. Let the grinder do its thing and not press the nail down too hard.  Another key note to think about is that nail dust is fine and easi

Loved this!!! I have 2 dogs, and neither of them minded me trimming their nails today!! It is light weight, and not super loud !!! The clippers are sharp and the battery powered file comes charged and works very well, I live the fact that it has a safety vuard so I cant trim their nails to short!!  Glad I bought this!!

This nail grinder is awesome! My dog can't stand the nail grinders that I've bought in the past, but he seems to not mind this at all! Love that it comes with all the extra goodies too! Highly Recommend

I have had a dremel for years to use on my 4 Boston Terriers.  I have two that don't mind it much, but have always hated the noise.  I have two that I have to wrestle into position and hold and start over and over and over.  The new Bark & Boop Dog Nail Grinder has almost the same power, but with a better grinder, I think.  It's so quiet, my favorite part.  It works so well.
My dog was not scared of this nail grinder at all!  It’s super quiet and works great!  My dog actually sat still the entire time and didn’t act bothered at all.  I would definitely recommend this!
Got it as a gift for my parents and they love it. Worked great on their dog who is usually terrified of getting their nails groomed. Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Works like how a nail grinder should work!
reviews.x: Love this grinder! Works like a dream on my dog. I told all of my friends about it!

reviews.t: Excellent value, very effective and safe.
reviews.x: Excellent value for the money! We just used this to trim our pups nails and I'm very satisfied with this purchase. All of the items pictured did come with the kit.  Grinder: Very quiet abd had very littke vibration which is excellent because my pup is easily scared by noises. It was very efficient. Gentle enough that I wasnt worried about filing too much off but strong enough to quickly do the job.  My only complaint would be that I wish the USB charged cane with a wall block. I know most of us

Unfortunately I didn’t get a before picture of my dogs gigantic talons of nails, because I was just so excited to use this item, but the picture i provided is to give you an idea of how much work is lined up for this amazing grinder!  My dog is a 95lb boxer/malamute mutt (so I’ve been told). She’s got very strong, very thick nails that grow very quickly in the front and she’s very uneasy around grinders, as we usually have to take her in and they have to either sedate or muzzle her to grind her

reviews.t: Game Changer for my Anxious Doggie
reviews.x: I LOVVVVVE this product. I would give it more stars if I could. My dog has really bad anxiety. She doesn't like manicure day no matter how luxurious and relaxing I try to make it. I’ve tried everything from pedi paws to the drummer nail grinder. BUT the Bark & Boop nail grinder and file has saved us and made nail day so much easier. The grinder is so quiet and smooth that my dog even FELL ASLEEP during the whole process. FELL ASLEEP. This is a total game changer for me and her. Manicure day seem

My dogs hate getting their nails clipped so I figured I would give this a shot. Its fairly quiet, but not as quiet as other reviews made it out to be. As soon as you touch it to a nail it's no longer quiet so that kinda defeats the purpose lol but they dont mind it near as much as the clippers so I can get 3-4 nails done before they are annoyed.

I ordered a limited time kit that was to include a nail clippers and file as well and all I got was the nail grinder. Which works, but I should have received everything in the picture and description. Or should have been informed otherwise. Was set to trim my dogs nails and can’t because of missing pieces.

reviews.t: It’s the Best of the Best!!!
reviews.x: The Bark & Boop Nail Grinder is the best of the best. It had a five star rating and it deserved it. There is virtually no sound when you turn it on. It offers you 3 different ways to care of all dog sizes. It’s a family owned business that really cares for its customers.

This was not worth the trouble at first it seem great but it would only be for maintenance And then after putting the tool back into box to keep it organized It broke trying to take it out to use the second time the white casing is not durable that is what broke

reviews.t: this is an AWESOME nail grinder
reviews.x: We tried a nail grinder int he past and hated it...decided to give another one a try based on the good reviews...SO glad we did. This thing is awesome! It's super quiet, it's gentle, it doesn't heat up much at all...it was very easy to adapt our critters to it.

This product does a great job.  It’s small but mighty!  Low noise, comes with an extra head.  My little girl has gotten use to getting her little toes pedicured by this.  If you are a protective pet parent, like we are this is a great product.

reviews.t: It works good dog didn't really like it at first
reviews.x: The product works good nice little kid my dog didn't like it at first but I got tired of going to the vet paying $25 to get her nails cut and $25 to get her put to sleep to get her nails cut had to do it myself save myself some money

reviews.t: Very quiet and doesn’t require batteries
reviews.x: This is the best pet nail grinder I’ve used.  It’s usb charged. So no need to buy batteries.  Also, I’m able to use it at a more comfortable angle.  It’s also quiet, which is a wonderful change compared to my last nail grinder.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the grinder for being quiet and not startling their pets.
Many customers say the product works well and is easy to use on their dogs.
Several reviewers highlight that their pets, including fearful or skittish ones, tolerate the grinder well.
Some customers note the kit includes useful extras like clippers and a file, though one reviewer reported missing items.
A few reviewers compare it favorably to a Dremel, citing similar power with less noise.
